back: mean = mean + (x − mean) / n, where n includes the new value.
n += 1; delta = x − mean; mean += delta / n; M2 += delta · (x − mean). Variance = M2/n or M2/(n−1).
Catastrophic cancellation: two huge, almost equal numbers are subtracted, so precision is lost.

front: How do you merge two (n, mean, M2) groups?
back: delta = mean_b − mean_a; mean = mean_a + delta·n_b/n; M2 = M2_a + M2_b + delta²·n_a·n_b/n.
O(1) time per value and O(1) memory in total.
